en.meta_title: Canban — Keep your agent CLI. Automate your workflow.
en.meta_desc: Lightweight native macOS & Linux Kanban workbench for Claude Code, Codex, Antigravity, Cursor CLI, Pi, and 20+ native agent CLIs with Notification Center and GitHub Actions-like workflows.
en.hero_title: Keep your agent CLI. Automate your workflow.
en.hero_description: Organize context on flexible cards, catch waiting agents in one notification center, and automate tasks with GitHub Actions-like workflows.
